name: protein A (RdRp)
note: RNA1 replicase, 981-983 aa. Carries mitochondrial targeting signals (GGNNV aa 215-255, PMID 15163743; AHNV aa 1-40 and 225-246, PMID 17602779). No cleavage products described.

name: B1
note: 111 aa (336 nt gene) in RGNNV, in frame with protein A and sharing its stop, from sgRNA3. An anti-necrotic death factor. NO START CODON IS PUBLISHED and no RefSeq annotates a B1 CDS, so this collection is extracted from genomes under a structural gate.

name: B2
note: 75 aa, +1 frame relative to protein A, from sgRNA3, which begins at RNA1 nt 2730 by premature termination rather than splicing. RNAi antagonist and necrotic death factor.

name: coat protein
note: 338-340 aa, a single UNCLEAVED chain. The RNA2 ORF carries the catalytic D-75 residue but lacks the autocatalytic cleavage site, so there is no alpha/beta/gamma maturation in this genus.

name: capsid beta/gamma maturation products
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. Betanodavirus CP is not proteolytically cleaved (PMID 9672600), and the T=3 crystal structure is built from the intact 338-residue chain (PMID 26491970). ABSENT here is the correct and expected result: it confirms the alphanodavirus cleavage rule has not leaked into this module.
